rendered_curve:
Reset-axis retention curve  (system: agentic-retrieval-llm)
  prior   P  (stateless baseline) = 0.0000  [0.000,0.000]
  ceiling C  (no-reset, k=0)      = 0.5446  [0.446,0.634]
  band    C - P                   = 0.5446
  epsilon                         = 0.0286  (r_max = 0.5714)

    k  schedule             R(k)  95% CI           norm_gain  95% CI              W(3)   W_norm  clbench_gain    n
  ---  ----------------  -------  ---------------  ---------  ---------------  -------  -------  ------------  ---
    1  boundaries:48      0.5625  [0.473,0.652]        1.033  [0.803,1.309]     1.0000    1.500        0.5625  112

  norm_gain = (R(k) - P) / max(C - P, eps);  eps = 0.05 x r_max unless overridden;  clbench_gain = CL-Bench mean_gain vs prior (== R(k) - P).
  W(3) = mean reward over the first 3 instances after each reset (pooled; truncated at the next reset/run end) — separates 'retained' from 'relearned fast'.  W_norm applies the band formula to the matched-ordinal window means.  CIs are percentile bootstrap over per-instance outcomes.
